description: Average the wins gained at each individual race (running count minus the previous round's count in the same season) over each country's standings rows.

a.request: Link constructor standings to their races and circuits. For each circuit country, compute the average number of wins gained at that race (the running `constructorStandings.wins` minus the constructor's value at its previous round in the same season, or minus 0 if there is no earlier round) across that country's standings rows. Keep the countries whose average is above the mean of all country averages, and note how far each is above it. Among those, keep the countries whose average is also above the mean of the kept countries' averages, and note how far each is above that second mean. Return one row with three unrounded values: the mean of these final countries' average wins, the mean of their excess over the all-country mean, and the mean of their excess over the above-average group's mean.
a.sql:
WITH standings_with_previous AS (
  SELECT
    c.country,
    cs.wins - COALESCE(
      LAG(cs.wins) OVER (
        PARTITION BY cs.constructorId, r.year
        ORDER BY r.round
      ),
      0
    ) AS wins_gained
  FROM constructorStandings AS cs
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
), country_averages AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(wins_gained) AS avg_wins
  FROM standings_with_previous
  GROUP BY country
), all_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_all
  FROM country_averages
), above_all AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins, am.mean_all
  FROM country_averages AS ca
  CROSS JOIN all_mean AS am
  WHERE ca.avg_wins > am.mean_all
), above_all_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_above_all
  FROM above_all
), final_countries AS (
  SELECT aa.avg_wins, aa.mean_all, aam.mean_above_all
  FROM above_all AS aa
  CROSS JOIN above_all_mean AS aam
  WHERE aa.avg_wins > aam.mean_above_all
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_final_avg_wins,
  AVG(avg_wins - mean_all) AS mean_excess_over_all_country_mean,
  AVG(avg_wins - mean_above_all) AS mean_excess_over_above_average_group_mean
FROM final_countries;

b.request: For each country where races are held, average the constructors’ wins gained at each race across its constructor standings rows, deriving each race’s wins as the season-to-date running count minus the previous round’s count in the same season. Select countries whose average exceeds the overall average across all countries, then select those whose average also exceeds the average for that above-average group. Return one row containing three unrounded figures: the mean of the selected countries’ averages, the mean amount by which those averages exceed the overall average, and the mean amount by which they exceed the above-average group’s average
b.sql:
WITH race_wins AS (
  SELECT
    r.year,
    r.round,
    c.country,
    cs.constructorId,
    cs.wins - COALESCE(
      LAG(cs.wins) OVER (
        PARTITION BY r.year, cs.constructorId
        ORDER BY r.round
      ),
      0
    ) AS wins_gained
  FROM constructorStandings AS cs
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
), country_averages AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(wins_gained) AS avg_wins
  FROM race_wins
  GROUP BY country
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM country_averages
), above_overall AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins
  FROM country_averages AS ca
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.avg_wins
), above_group AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM above_overall
), selected AS (
  SELECT aa.avg_wins
  FROM above_overall AS aa
  CROSS JOIN above_group AS ag
  WHERE aa.avg_wins > ag.avg_wins
)
SELECT
  AVG(s.avg_wins) AS mean_selected_country_average,
  AVG(s.avg_wins - o.avg_wins) AS mean_excess_overall_average,
  AVG(s.avg_wins - ag.avg_wins) AS mean_excess_above_group_average
FROM selected AS s
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
CROSS JOIN above_group AS ag;

c.request: For each country where races are held, look at the average constructor wins per standings entry at its races. Take the countries above the overall average, and then those of them that are also above the average of that above-average group. Give one row with three unrounded figures: the mean of those countries' average wins, the mean of how far they exceed the overall average, and the mean of how far they exceed the above-average group's average. Average the wins gained at each individual race (running count minus the previous round's count in the same season) over each country's standings rows.
c.sql:
WITH constructor_race_wins AS (
    SELECT
        cs.raceId,
        cs.constructorId,
        cs.wins - COALESCE(prev.wins, 0) AS race_wins
    FROM constructorStandings AS cs
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
    LEFT JOIN races AS pr
        ON pr.year = r.year
       AND pr.round = r.round - 1
    LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS prev
        ON prev.raceId = pr.raceId
       AND prev.constructorId = cs.constructorId
),
country_averages AS (
    SELECT c.country, AVG(crw.race_wins) AS avg_wins
    FROM constructor_race_wins AS crw
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = crw.raceId
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    GROUP BY c.country
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg FROM country_averages
),
above_overall AS (
    SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins
    FROM country_averages AS ca
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.overall_avg
),
above_group AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS group_avg FROM above_overall
),
selected AS (
    SELECT ao.avg_wins, o.overall_avg, ag.group_avg
    FROM above_overall AS ao
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    CROSS JOIN above_group AS ag
    WHERE ao.avg_wins > ag.group_avg
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_country_average_wins,
    AVG(avg_wins - overall_avg) AS mean_excess_overall_average,
    AVG(avg_wins - group_avg) AS mean_excess_above_average_group
FROM selected;

d.request: For each country where races are held, average the wins gained at each individual race across that country’s standings rows. Calculate each race’s wins gained as the running constructor wins count minus the count from the previous round in the same season. Then take the countries whose average is above the overall average, and from those select the countries whose average is also above that group’s average. Return one row with three unrounded figures: the selected countries’ mean average wins, their mean excess over the overall average, and their mean excess over the above-average group’s average.
d.sql:
WITH constructor_race_wins_gained AS (
  SELECT
    r.raceId,
    r.year,
    r.round,
    c.country,
    cs.constructorId,
    cs.wins - COALESCE(
      LAG(cs.wins) OVER (
        PARTITION BY r.year, cs.constructorId
        ORDER BY r.round
      ),
      0
    ) AS wins_gained
  FROM constructorStandings AS cs
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
), country_averages AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(wins_gained) AS avg_wins
  FROM constructor_race_wins_gained
  GROUP BY country
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(wins_gained) AS avg_wins
  FROM constructor_race_wins_gained
), above_overall AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins
  FROM country_averages AS ca
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.avg_wins
), group_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM above_overall
), selected AS (
  SELECT ao.avg_wins
  FROM above_overall AS ao
  CROSS JOIN group_average AS ga
  WHERE ao.avg_wins > ga.avg_wins
)
SELECT
  AVG(s.avg_wins) AS mean_average_wins,
  AVG(s.avg_wins - o.avg_wins) AS mean_excess_over_overall_average,
  AVG(s.avg_wins - ga.avg_wins) AS mean_excess_over_above_average_group
FROM selected AS s
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
CROSS JOIN group_average AS ga;
